original_prefix: Original MiniLM vectors exist for all indexed snapshots, including unresolved. CpuEmbeddingComparer rejects unknown spans and ambiguous identities before neighbour cap.

report_backgrounds.influence: potential sparse IDF/rank competition; fixed unchanged background retained

source_loader: common.load verifies each retained raw snapshot body hash matches immutable background document; unresolved rows keep raw snapshot code, tokens and old prefix vectors, line0/end-1 placeholders. No silent drop or refit.
sparse: All original documents remain in TFIDF fit and vocabulary. Sparse candidates can consume retrieval ranks, but unknown spans fail the common logical funding ledger. Thus affected background findings are qualified; no source-negative labels assigned.
tail: Only native-resolved statement views encoded. Raw operation score arrays can compare query views against unresolved prefix vectors, but OperationIndex.neighbours rejects their unknown spans/ambiguous identities before cap. They are excluded from discovery/diagnostic query populations.
whole_file: Paid selections separately pass canonical whole-file parsing; historical native-resolved count is function/body/span resolution, not a claim of strict whole-file validation of every competitor.
